name: sync-no-markfailed
description: a failed sync sets no retry mark (MarkFailed dropped)
old: failed: f.failed || f.hash is Some, ..f }

name: sync-ignores-retry-marks
description: ComputeChanges pass 3 dropped: a file with a retry mark is not forced through
old: f.owned && (f.hash != Some(f.disk) || f.failed || (run_tests && f.pending))

name: sync-commit-without-load
description: a successful sync commits the new hash without loading the file
old: F { server: Some(f.disk), hash: Some(f.disk), failed: false,

name: compile-stamps-on-failure
description: the dev-mode compile records baselines even when it fails
old: if ok && !skip { stamp_all(m1) } else { m1 }

name: reload-drops-server-copy
description: reload removes the server copy instead of loading the disk bytes
old: if m.files[p].owned { F { server: Some(m.files[p].disk), ..m.files[p] } } else { m.files[p] }), ..m } }
new: if m.files[p].owned { F { server: None, ..m.files[p] } } else { m.files[p] }), ..m } }

name: edit-updates-baseline
description: an edit on disk also rewrites the stored baseline
old: M { files: m.files.insert(p, F { disk: b, ..m.files[p] }), ..m }
new: M { files: m.files.insert(p, F { disk: b, hash: Some(b), ..m.files[p] }), ..m }

name: no-premise-out
description: drop defect premise OUT (F-SYNC-1) for compile and load
old:
!(ok && !skip) ==> forall |p: int| #[trigger] m.files.dom().contains(p) && m.files[p].owned && (ok || loaded.contains(p))
        && m.files[p].hash is Some && !m.files[p].failed ==> m.files[p].hash == Some(m.files[p].disk)

name: no-premise-out-reload
description: drop defect premise OUT (F-SYNC-1) for reload
old:
m.dev ==> forall |p: int| #[trigger] m.files.dom().contains(p) && m.files[p].owned
        && m.files[p].hash is Some && !m.files[p].failed ==> m.files[p].hash == Some(m.files[p].disk)

name: no-premise-base
description: drop defect premise BASE (F-SYNC-2)
old:
m.dev && !has_baseline(m) ==> forall |p: int| #[trigger] m.files.dom().contains(p) && m.files[p].owned
        ==> m.files[p].server == Some(m.files[p].disk)

name: l1-sync-no-success-rule
description: vacuity: L1 sync without 'success leaves server = disk' must lose the F-SYNC-1 witness
old: &&& ok ==> forall |p: int| #[trigger] b.dom().contains(p) && b[p].owned ==> b[p].server == Some(b[p].disk)

name: l1-sync-server-present
description: vacuity: L1 sync that only asks for a server copy must lose the F-SYNC-2 witness
old:
b[p].owned ==> b[p].server == Some(b[p].disk)
}

name: l1-sync-success-on-loaded-only
description: vacuity: L1 sync that checks only files whose baseline changed must lose the reload witness
old:
b[p].owned ==> b[p].server == Some(b[p].disk)
}

name: l1-sync-success-allows-old-copy
description: vacuity: L1 sync success that also allows the old server copy must lose the -skip-sync witness
old:
b[p].owned ==> b[p].server == Some(b[p].disk)
}

name: commit-keeps-retry-mark
description: CommitChanges leaves SyncFailed set
old: F { server: Some(f.disk), hash: Some(f.disk), failed: false,
new: F { server: Some(f.disk), hash: Some(f.disk), failed: f.failed,

name: failed-sync-rewrites-baseline
description: a failed sync writes the new hash
old: F { server: if was_loaded { Some(f.disk) } else { f.server }, failed: f.failed || f.hash is Some, ..f }
new: F { server: if was_loaded { Some(f.disk) } else { f.server }, hash: Some(f.disk), failed: f.failed || f.hash is Some, ..f }

name: stamp-clears-marks
description: StampModule clears retry marks
old: M { files: Map::new(m.files.dom(), |p: int| F { hash: Some(m.files[p].disk), ..m.files[p] }), ..m }
new: M { files: Map::new(m.files.dom(), |p: int| F { hash: Some(m.files[p].disk), failed: false, ..m.files[p] }), ..m }

name: first-sync-loads
description: a sync with no baseline loads the files instead of only stamping
old: else if !has_baseline(m) { stamp_all(m) }

name: reload-stamps
description: reload records baselines
old:
else { M { files: Map::new(m.files.dom(), |p: int|
                   if m.files[p].owned { F { server: Some(m.files[p].disk), ..m.files[p] } } else { m.files[p] }), ..m } }
new:
else { M { files: Map::new(m.files.dom(), |p: int|
                   if m.files[p].owned { F { server: Some(m.files[p].disk), hash: Some(m.files[p].disk), ..m.files[p] } } else { m.files[p] }), ..m } }

name: no-mark-test-pending
description: MarkTestPending dropped
old: pending: if run_tests { false } else { f.pending || f.test }, ..f }
new: pending: if run_tests { false } else { f.pending }, ..f }

name: sync-worked-reports-failure
description: finding 1: a sync whose loads, compile and tests worked reports failure
old: else { ok && (!run_tests || tests_ok) }

name: sync-test-failure-reports-success
description: finding 1: a failing test no longer fails the sync command (SYNC-B31)
old: else { ok && (!run_tests || tests_ok) }

name: sync-compile-failure-reports-success
description: finding 1: a failed load or compile reports success
old: else { ok && (!run_tests || tests_ok) }

name: sync-nothing-to-sync-reports-failure
description: finding 1: a sync with nothing to apply reports failure
old: else if !has_baseline(m) || !any_detected(m, run_tests) { true }
new: else if !has_baseline(m) { true } else if !any_detected(m, run_tests) { false }

name: sync-not-dev-reports-success
description: finding 1: a sync refused for a module not in developer mode reports success (SYNC-B1)
old:
if !m.dev { false }
    else if !has_baseline(m)
